title: She Spikes The Rooftop Tea — Part 5

series.summary: At the rooftop tea party Kusuri admits she thinks her last batch failed. She runs off, returns with two thermoses, and pours for everyone.

segments.voiceover_text: On the rooftop, everyone sits down for tea. It should be a calm afternoon. Karane blushes at nothing. Kusuri goes very quiet.
Then Kusuri admits it. She thinks her last batch was a failure. She says it lightly, shrugging it off, but the doubt is real and Rentarou hears it.
So she fixes it herself. She bolts inside, fists shaking with excitement, and comes back with two thermoses. One is marked for five people. One is only for him.
Everyone drinks. Hearts bloom over the rooftop. Kusuri peeks around the corner, beaming.
